positive_screen.message_en: Your answers suggest that a more complete assessment may be helpful. This result does not automatically determine eligibility for assistance.

negative_screen.title_en: No elevated risk detected from this quick screening
negative_screen.message_en: This does not prove that the household is not vulnerable. The quick screen can miss households that need support. You may request a complete assessment.

insufficient_information.message_en: Fewer than 60% of the questions were answered. Please provide more information or request an assisted assessment.

limited_information.message_en: Between 60% and 79% of the questions were answered. Interpret this screening result with additional caution.

small_household_notice.message_en: This quick screen has lower sensitivity for smaller households. If you have concerns or are seeking support, please request a complete professional assessment even when the screening score is below the threshold.

required_ui_actions: Always provide a route to professional assessment.
Never use the prediction alone to deny assistance.
Show data completeness with every result.
Show the small-household notice when applicable.
Do not display province as a causal risk factor.
Provide Kinyarwanda and English result explanations.
Require native-speaker review of Kinyarwanda translations.
model_policy: The model and threshold are frozen. Fairness test results must not be used for post-test model tuning.
